_: English for the 準爸媽 results (src/baby-app.js), keyed by the Chinese as written there (README「英文版（翻譯層）」). Names stay in characters with their romanisation; the medical caution stays first in the birth-window section. Check with: node scripts/extract-strings.mjs --check

story.請填完整的日期和時間。: Please fill in both the date and the time.
story.這個時段只有 {weeks}，還不到 {min} 週。{min} 週以前的擇期剖: This window is only {weeks}, short of {min} weeks. An elective caesarean before {min} weeks raises the newborn’s risks, so it is not compared here.
story.這個時段已經 {weeks}，超過 {max} 週，請和醫師討論，這裡不提供比較: This window is already {weeks}, past {max} weeks. Please talk it over with your doctor; it is not compared here.
story.請填寶寶的姓氏（一到兩個中文字）。: Please fill in the baby’s surname (one or two Chinese characters).
story.請至少填一個候選名字（不含姓）。: Please fill in at least one candidate given name (without the surname).
story.候選名字請填一到三個中文字，不含姓。: Each candidate name should be one to three Chinese characters, without the surname.
story.請填出生日期（或預產期），年份在 1900 到 2100 年之間。: Please fill in the date of birth (or the due date), between 1900 and 2100.
story.請選出生的時辰，或勾選「還不知道時辰」。: Please pick the two-hour period of birth, or tick “Time not yet known”.
story.請輸入出生時間，或改選時辰、勾選「還不知道時辰」。: Please enter the time of birth, or pick a two-hour period, or tick “Time not yet known”.
story.比較出生時段要先填預產期。: To compare birth windows, fill in the due date first.
story.這個日期或地點沒辦法排盤，請再檢查一次。: A chart could not be drawn up for this date or place. Please check them again.
story.{date}{time}在{place}出生的{baby}。每個名字都用同一張命: A {baby} born {date}{time}, in {place}. Every name is compared on the same chart over the same {runs} lives, so the only difference is the name.
story.日主{dayMaster}・{strength}・{pattern}；{role: Day Master (日主): {dayMaster} · {strength} · {pattern}; {roles}. When a name’s characters carry the Useful or a favourable element, tradition calls it “supplementing the chart” (補八字).
story.性別還不知道：男寶寶和女寶寶的四柱一樣，只有大運的方向相反，模擬時一半用男寶寶、: The sex is not yet known: a boy and a girl born at the same moment share the four pillars, and only their Luck Pillars run in opposite directions, so half the lives are simulated as a boy and half as a girl.
story.這個名字沒辦法分析。: This name could not be analysed.
story.用這個名字開始一生: Start a life with this name
story.「{names}」同分最高（{score} 分）: {names} share the highest traditional name-analysis score ({score} points)
story.「{name}」的傳統姓名學評分最高（{score} 分）: {name} has the highest traditional name-analysis score ({score} points)
story.，用字裡的「{chars}」補到寶寶的喜用五行: , and with {chars} it supplies the baby’s favourable elements
story.{runs} 次人生裡，幾個名字的差別最多 {spread} 次{almost}: Over {runs} lives, the names differ by at most {spread} {spread:life:lives}{almost}. A name’s effect in this simulation is very small to begin with (at most ±5% in each area of life): a name you both love to say, with a good meaning, that your child will find easy to write, matters more than the score.
story.名字在這個模擬裡的影響很小（每個領域最多 ±5%），比較兩個以上的名字時，可以看: A name’s effect in this simulation is very small (at most ±5% in each area of life); compare two or more names to see how they differ.
story.{baby}：17–76 歲的大運有 {good} 步喜用、{hard} 步忌運: {baby:cap}: from 17 to 76, {good} favourable Luck Pillar{good:s} and {hard} unfavourable
story.17–76 歲的大運有 {good} 步喜用、{hard} 步忌運{best}: From 17 to 76, {good} favourable Luck Pillar{good:s} and {hard} unfavourable{best}
story.，最旺是 {from}–{to} 歲的{pillar}運: , the strongest being the {pillar} Luck Pillar at {from}–{to}
story.日主{dayMaster}・{strength}・{pattern}，用神不明顯: Day Master {dayMaster} · {strength} · {pattern}; no clear Useful Element. {luck}.
story.{runs} 次人生的平均心情 {mood}；大學以上 {university}: Over {runs} lives: average mood {mood}; university or higher in {university}, married in {married}, a home of their own in {home}.
story.剖腹或催生的時間，請以醫師的醫療判斷為準。研究顯示，懷孕滿 {weeks} 週以: The timing of a caesarean or an induction is a medical decision: follow your doctor. Research shows that an elective caesarean before {weeks} full weeks of pregnancy raises the newborn’s risk of breathing and other problems, and Taiwan’s obstetrics society says the hour of birth has no medical meaning. Only windows from {from} to {to} ({weeks} to 42 weeks of pregnancy) are compared here, ranked by the traditional run of the Luck Pillars{named}; lifespan and health are not compared.
story.合盤只讓童年的家庭事件、學業和彼此相處的事件機率傾斜（最多 ±15%），說的是相: In these notes, “you” is the baby. The match only tilts the odds of childhood family events, school and getting along (at most ±15%): it describes how you tend to get along, not who is better or worse.
story.性別還不知道：大運、六親和婚姻的看法依性別不同。: The sex is not yet known: the Luck Pillars, family and marriage readings differ by sex.
